title: Quick-Fix Roasted Hunan Cornstarch Jjigae
description: A low-sodium-friendly, al-dente-finish Hunan dish featuring cornstarch and a roasted finish.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in the skillet.
Add the sliced ginger and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chopped scallions and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the pork shoulder and cook until browned, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Add the Korean chili flakes, soy sauce, and 2 tablespoons of water mixed with cornstarch to the skillet.
Stir the mixture until it thickens, then serve hot.
Serve the Hunan cornstarch jjigae immediately over steamed rice.
Garnish with additional chopped scallions if desired.
Cook pork to an internal temperature of 63°C / 145°F and let it rest for 3 minutes before serving.
